task: It's time to explore the amazing world of TextWorld! First of all, open the door. And then, go to the north. And then, make an attempt to travel north. After that, go to the east. And then, take a trip north. Following that, move west. If you can do that, make an effort to travel north. And then, make an effort to go to the east. Then, attempt to go to the west. Then, recover the mug from the stand within the studio. And if you do that, you're the winner!
